pages.text: $(item)Street Track$() is set into the road: its grooved rails are level with the top of the block, so cars and people go over it. Place it in place of a road block.$(br2)Draw curves between street track blocks the same way as train track; click the top of a road block for a new end, and it's set into it.

Street corners can be as tight as a radius of 3 blocks, and are paid for in street track.$(br2)A street runs straight on into train track: lay train track on the ground in line with the street track's end (a block up from it, as the street track's set into the road) and they join up, near enough level.$(br2)It's made for $(l:electric/trams)trams$(/l), but any train runs on it.
Street track round a street corner.
The street running on into train track.
Three Train Track over stone and coal make six.
